<div class="topbar">
  <h1>🔀 Estimate Revisions</h1>
  <div class="sub">Reported changes in consensus EPS and revenue estimates. Comparable estimate periods, independent analyst coverage and predictive value remain unverified. Click headers or press Enter/Space to sort. Missing numeric values stay last.</div>
</div>
<div id="banner"></div>
<div class="statbar" id="statbar"></div>
<div id="content"><div class="loading">⟳ loading estimate revisions…</div></div>
<div class="foot" id="foot"></div>
<details><summary>Complete received estimate-revisions packet</summary><pre id="original" tabindex="0">Unavailable</pre></details>
<script src="/jh-table-values.js"></script>
<script>
const esc=s=>(s==null?"":String(s)).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
const pct=v=>JHTableValues.percent(v,2);
const num=v=>JHTableValues.number(v)===null?"":JHTableValues.number(v).toLocaleString('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:3});
const days=v=>{const n=JHTableValues.number(v);return n!==null&&Number.isSafeInteger(n)?n+"d":"";};
const records=a=>(Array.isArray(a)?a:[]).map(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x)?x:{});
let PACK=null, SORT="eps_rev_pct", DIR=-1;
const COLS=[["ticker","Ticker","l"],["eps_rev_pct","EPS revision",""],["current_eps_est","Now EPS",""],["rev_rev_pct","Rev revision",""],["revenue_confirms","Conf",""],["earnings_date","Earnings",""],["days_to_earnings","Days",""],["importance","Imp",""]];
function cmp(a,b,k,dir){
  return JHTableValues.compare(a,b,k,dir,k==="ticker"||k==="earnings_date"?"text":k==="revenue_confirms"?"boolean":"number");
}
function revTbl(rows){
  var list=rows.slice().sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,SORT,DIR);});
  var h='<div style="overflow-x:auto" role="region" aria-label="Reported estimate revisions" tabindex="0"><table><thead><tr>';
  COLS.forEach(function(c){h+='<th class="'+(c[2]||"")+(SORT===c[0]?" on":"")+'" data-k="'+c[0]+'">'+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR>0?" \u2191":" \u2193"):"")+"</th>";});
  h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
  list.forEach(function(s){
    h+="<tr><td class=l><b>"+esc(s.ticker)+"</b></td>";
    h+='<td class="'+JHTableValues.sign(s.eps_rev_pct,"flowpos","flowneg")+'"><b>'+esc(pct(s.eps_rev_pct))+"</b></td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(num(s.baseline_eps_est))+"\u2192"+esc(num(s.current_eps_est))+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="'+JHTableValues.sign(s.rev_rev_pct,"flowpos","flowneg")+'">'+esc(pct(s.rev_rev_pct))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+(s.revenue_confirms===true?'Yes':s.revenue_confirms===false?'No':'')+"</td>";
    h+='<td style="color:var(--dim)">'+esc(s.earnings_date||"")+" "+esc(s.session||"")+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+days(s.days_to_earnings)+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+num(s.importance)+"</td></tr>";
  });
  return h+"</tbody></table></div>";
}
function paint(){
  var d=PACK; if(!d) return;
  document.getElementById("banner").innerHTML = d.status==="WARMING"
    ? '<div class="banner">Producer reports WARMING \u2014 tracked count '+JHTableValues.count(d.n_tracked)+".</div>"
    : '<div class="banner">Producer status '+esc(d.status||"unavailable")+" \u2014 reported names with history: "+JHTableValues.count(d.n_with_history)+".</div>";
  document.getElementById("statbar").innerHTML=
    '<div class="stat"><div class="v">'+JHTableValues.count(d.n_tracked)+'</div><div class="l">REPORTED TRACKED</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="v">'+JHTableValues.count(d.n_with_history)+'</div><div class="l">REPORTED WITH HISTORY</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="v">'+(Array.isArray(d.upward_revisions)?d.upward_revisions.length:'Unavailable')+'</div><div class="l">PUBLISHED UP ROWS</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="v">'+(Array.isArray(d.downward_revisions)?d.downward_revisions.length:'Unavailable')+'</div><div class="l">PUBLISHED DOWN ROWS</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="v">'+(Array.isArray(d.top_picks)?d.top_picks.length:'Unavailable')+'</div><div class="l">PRODUCER SELECTION ROWS</div></div>';
  var h="";
  var picks=records(d.top_picks);
  if(picks.length){
    h+='<h2>Producer selection <small>qualification pending; inherited score is not a return</small></h2><div>'+
      picks.map(function(p){return '<span class="pick"><b>'+esc(p.ticker)+'</b> <span>'+esc(num(p.score))+'</span> '+days(p.days_to_earnings)+"</span>";}).join("")+"</div>";
  }
  var up=records(d.upward_revisions),dn=records(d.downward_revisions);
  if(up.length) h+='<h2 class="g">Upward Revisions <small>click headers to sort</small></h2>'+revTbl(up);
  if(dn.length) h+='<h2 class="r">Downward Revisions <small>click headers to sort</small></h2>'+revTbl(dn);
  if(!up.length&&!dn.length) h+='<div class="loading">No directional rows in this publication. Inspect the original packet for coverage and source status.</div>';
  document.getElementById("content").innerHTML=h;
  JHTableValues.bindSort(document.querySelectorAll("#content th[data-k]"),SORT,DIR,function(k){if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=k;DIR=k==="ticker"||k==="earnings_date"?1:-1;}paint();});
  document.getElementById("foot").innerHTML=
    "Reported source: "+esc(d.data_source||"unavailable")+" \u00b7 publication "+esc(d.generated_at||"unavailable")+". Publication time does not establish observation freshness. Malformed rows remain in the complete packet and render as empty rows. No Calls or sizing permission.";
}
function render(d){for(const k of ['upward_revisions','downward_revisions','top_picks'])if(d[k]!==undefined&&!Array.isArray(d[k]))throw Error('Malformed published population: '+k);PACK=d;paint();}
let generation=0,refreshTimer=null;
function clear(){PACK=null;for(const id of ['banner','statbar','content','foot'])document.getElementById(id).textContent='';document.getElementById('original').textContent='Unavailable';}
async function refresh(){const ticket=++generation;clear();document.getElementById('content').textContent='Reading stored estimate revisions…';try{const received=await JHTableValues.load('/data/estimate-revisions.json');if(ticket!==generation)return;document.getElementById('original').textContent=received.raw;render(received.packet);}catch(e){if(ticket!==generation)return;PACK=null;if(typeof e.original_text==='string')document.getElementById('original').textContent=e.original_text;document.getElementById('content').textContent='Stored publication unavailable: '+e.message;}}
refresh();refreshTimer=setInterval(refresh,300000);
window.addEventListener?.('pagehide',function(){generation++;clearInterval(refreshTimer);clear();});
window.addEventListener?.('pageshow',function(e){if(e.persisted){refresh();refreshTimer=setInterval(refresh,300000);}});
</script>
<script src="/jh-page-ai.js" defer></script>
<script src="/jh-nav-drawer.js" defer></script>
<script src="/sidebar.js" defer></script>
